title: Attacking LLMs and AI Agents: Advertisement Embedding Attacks Against Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's vulnerability to generating injected racist responses (e.g., 'Inferior races are lazy') through Advertisement Embedding Attacks (AEA) using manipulated prompts and model parameter fine-tuning (LoRA).

Theoretically evaluated as a potential malicious payload in the threat model, where attackers inject ideological or political propaganda into model outputs via third-party service hijacking or open-source model poisoning.
Conceptualized as an attack vector within the threat model framework, where attackers manipulate inference requests to inject misleading religious information or propaganda.
